leads.name: Sweet Chestnut, Doneraille Park
leads.why: Public OPW park (Doneraile Estate), but 39 minutes drive / 29 miles from Cork city, past the roughly-30-minute day-trip boundary. Register-listed, unchecked otherwise. Two more register trees at the same site (Quercus robur, Taxus baccata) would join it if this cluster is ever opened.

leads.name: Pedunculate Oak, Doneraille Park
leads.why: Same site and boundary issue as the Doneraille sweet chestnut above.

leads.name: Yew, Doneraille Park
leads.why: Same site and boundary issue as the Doneraille sweet chestnut above.

leads.name: Sessile Oak, The Gearagh, Macroom
leads.why: A national nature reserve (alluvial oak woodland), genuinely public, but roughly 35-40 minutes from Cork city, past the day-trip boundary and further from any existing cluster. Register-listed, unchecked otherwise.
